'''Vessel three-niner''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that served the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. It was assigned to [[Kline Security]] operating in the [[Monor system/Legends|Monor system]]. The crew of the vessel intercepted a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spacetug/Legends|tug]] and captured [[Daye Azur-Jamin]], [[Toalar Yalom Yalom]], and [[Woyiq]].
